3 methyl groups distinct each? Possibly each methyl is unique environment.

We have O atoms? Not sure.

Actually the central carbon is attached to three methyls and one hydrogen; no open valence. So maybe the fragment is a tert-butyl? Wait central carbon has valence 4: three methyls and one hydrogen, no open valence. So cannot connect further. So maybe the fragment is a butyl chain: CH3-CH(CH3)-CH3? That's isobutane, which is saturated, no open valence. So maybe the connection is at one of the terminal methyl groups? But they are saturated.
